flows.desc: Open /components in the built site and count cards per family heading. Expected: exactly 7 family sections render in a stable order — conversation, message, prompt-input, reasoning, sources, suggestion, tool — and their card counts sum to exactly 39. Every registry:component name in src/data/registry-items.json appears on exactly one card, and no card links anywhere except to a real /components/{item} page that exists in dist/.

Iterate all 39 cards on /components. Expected: each renders (1) the item title, (2) its one-line registry description (non-empty, at most 120 chars, equal to the enriched item's description field or its word-boundary clamp), (3) a category chip, and (4) an Expo Go verdict badge whose text is exactly one of the two verdict states ('runs in Expo Go' / 'requires a dev client'). No card has an empty description, a missing chip, or a blank/placeholder badge — the count assertion cards_with_all_fields == 39 holds.
